read.thesis: A share buyback notice, not an operating read: DKK 3.8bn programme concluded at avg DKK 257.47 per B share, with DKK 15bn 12-month programme still ahead. No supply, pricing or utilisation signal.

guidance.value: Up to DKK 15 billion over 12 months from 4 February 2026
guidance.quote: Novo Nordisk expects to repurchase B shares for an amount up to DKK 15 billion during a 12- month period beginning 4 February 2026.
